description: Every external source used by HKU Voxel Campus, with licence status. Checked before modelling began.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap (via Overpass API)
sources.dataUsed: HKU Main Campus boundary (relation 4246029); building footprints and tags; roads, footpaths, steps, bridges; water, coastline, woodland, grass, gardens; pitches, car parks, squares; entrances, MTR station and exits, named points.
sources.shippedInSite: Derived block data only (rasterised and meshed). Raw extract cached in data/raw/ (git-ignored).
sources.restrictions: Attribution required; derived databases must stay under ODbL. Queried once by script for a bounded study-area polygon — the website never calls Overpass.

sources.name: Lands Department, HKSAR Government — Digital Terrain Model (5 m grid)
sources.licence: DATA.GOV.HK Terms and Conditions of Use
sources.dataUsed: Whole_HK_DTM_5m.asc cropped to the study area (326 × 249 cells), resampled to a 1 m grid.
sources.attribution: Terrain: Digital Terrain Model © The Government of the Hong Kong SAR (Lands Department), from DATA.GOV.HK
sources.restrictions: Free for commercial and non-commercial use provided the source is identified and the Government's ownership acknowledged. Published accuracy ±5 m; surface may include vegetation and elevated structures.

sources.name: Lands Department, HKSAR Government — Building (polygons with names and heights)
sources.licence: DATA.GOV.HK Terms and Conditions of Use
sources.dataUsed: 1,604 building polygons in the study area (CSDI dataset landsd_rcd_1637211194312_35158): building names (English / Chinese), base and top heights, podium / tower type.
sources.role: Official names for buildings that OpenStreetMap leaves unnamed; building heights; the podium / tower split. Footprints still come from OpenStreetMap.
sources.shippedInSite: Derived block heights and building names. A slim copy of the polygons and attributes is kept in data/processed/ for reproducible builds.
sources.attribution: Building names and heights: Building data © The Government of the Hong Kong SAR (Lands Department), from DATA.GOV.HK
sources.restrictions: Free for commercial and non-commercial use provided the source is identified and the Government's ownership acknowledged. Heights are top minus base level of each polygon; they are matched to OSM footprints by overlap, which can mis-assign values where the two datasets disagree.

sources.name: The University of Hong Kong — official HKU Campus Map and its location data
sources.licence: © The University of Hong Kong (site footer notice). No open licence stated.
sources.dataUsed: Official location names (English / Chinese), building codes, campus grouping, facility names and the published map points.
sources.role: Authoritative naming and campus semantics; cross-check of building placement.
sources.shippedInSite: Factual names, codes, campus ids and point coordinates only, with attribution. Raw responses, contact details, photographs and map artwork are NOT shipped.
sources.derivativesPublishable: Facts only — not an open dataset. Seek permission from HKU before any commercial use.
sources.attribution: Building names and codes: official HKU Campus Map (© The University of Hong Kong)
sources.restrictions: Not open data. This project is unofficial and not affiliated with or endorsed by HKU. The Centennial Campus / halls grouping is a project grouping of official locations.

sources.name: Photographs published with official HKU Campus Map entries
sources.licence: © The University of Hong Kong. All rights reserved.
sources.dataUsed: Viewed privately to understand façade colours, roof forms, massing and approximate floor counts.
sources.role: Private visual reference for bespoke landmark models, palette hints and height estimates.
sources.shippedInSite: Nothing. No photograph or derivative image is included.

sources.name: Lands Department — Hong Kong Imagery Map API
sources.licence: CSDI / Hong Kong Map Service terms of use
sources.role: Identified as a lawful source for future visual validation of footprints, paths and vegetation. Not used to build or texture the model.
sources.derivativesPublishable: Subject to its terms; attribution and Lands Department logo required when displayed.
sources.restrictions: Would be a private validation reference only; never draped over the model.

notUsed: Google Maps / Google Earth, Bing Maps, Apple Maps, Mapbox imagery — not used in any form.
Minecraft / Mojang textures, sounds, logos, fonts or game files — none. All block textures are procedural and original.
